SASBDB entry SASDP74  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDP74/)

Publication: Structure of SALL4 zinc finger domain reveals link between AT-rich DNA binding and Okihiro syndrome.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.26508/lsa.202201588  (open access, PMC9838217)

The files are the downloads, unchanged (nothing was cleaned):
  experimental_data/SASDP74.dat   the curve (q in 1/A; columns q, I, error; free-text header and frame-bookkeeping trailer)
  SASDP74_fit2.fit                the CRYSOL fit of "fit2" (q in 1/A; columns q, Iexp, Ierr, Icalc)
  SASDP74_fit2_model1.pdb         the atomic model of "fit2": PDB 8A4I chains C and D (12-bp AT-rich duplex, heavy atoms only)
                                  (https://www.sasbdb.org/media/pdb_file/SASDP74_fit2_model1.pdb)
  8A4I.pdb                        the RCSB entry the model was cut from (https://files.rcsb.org/download/8A4I.pdb); the
                                  coordinates of chains C and D are identical to the SASBDB model
Only fit2 is used; fit1 (DAMMIN dummy-atom model, chi2 1.032) is not an atomic model.
Script: test/fitting_tests/SASDP74/ cites the buffer from the SASBDB entry and the paper (SAXS Methods).

Audit (2026-11-13, round 5): buffer, SEC step, dsDNA-alone sample and CRYSOL use checked against the paper (Methods "SAXS", p. 10; Results p. 3). Temperature and wavelength are SASBDB-only (supplementary Table S3 not available).
